attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his own newsletter post, stated in his own voice.

semantics.note: Faithful wording. It keeps 'several', the suicide and murder categories, the Wikipedia-tracking element, and the point that these are reports, not proven causes.

contract.note: Fair, ordinary plain reading: at least three distinct reported deaths, including both suicide and homicide, plus a Wikipedia article dated before the post. It does not require proof of causation, which matches 'reports' and 'associated'.

evidence.note: Permanent Wikipedia revision dated Jan 14, 2026, one day before the post. It collects many reported chatbot-linked suicides and the Greenwich murder-suicide.
Senate committee account from Sep 2025. It publicly records parents reporting chatbot-associated suicides (Garcia's son, Adam Raine).
Complaint dated Dec 11, 2025. It alleges ChatGPT fed the delusions behind Soelberg's murder of his mother and his own suicide. It is an allegation, which is enough to show a report existed.

reviews.rationale: Before Jan 15, 2026, public records described more than three distinct chatbot-associated deaths, including suicides (Setzer, Raine, Lacey, others) and a homicide (Adams). A Wikipedia revision dated Jan 14, 2026 collected these cases. Every element of the support condition is met, and no counterevidence was found.
